title: Of War and Ruin
author: Cahill, Ryan
review:
A little mixed on this even though overall I really liked it. Felt a bit uneven for me especially depending on the POV and what they're doing at the moment. The highs are high and the lows are low, the boring parts are a bit of a slog as well and a bit bloated, could have used some trimming down. Don't think this book needed to be 1500 pages for any reason. One of the storylines should have been completely cut as should the repeated training sections and there's a lot of repeated phrases sprinkled throughout the book.

That being said and how negative it sounds I did really like a lot of the big epic moments and some of the chapters and POVs were quite good and exciting. Overall this series is entertaining, I don't think it's that deep but it's a fun time and some of the world building and plot is a little under developed. I am looking forward to book 4, a lot was set up here that has a lot of potential, just wish we got even more here for how much of a squirrel squisher this book is.
